title: 30-Minute Cheese Stuffed Garlic Bread Rolls
description: Quick Garlic Bread Rolls packed with pockets of melty, gooey mozzarella cheese brushed on top with garlic-herb butter. One of the best skillet breads ever!

source.rights: Easy and Delish. Functional content plus a link, for internal app testing. Not redistributed.

items.raw: 16 oz crescent rolls ((I used Pillsbury -- Original))
items.name: crescent rolls ((I used Pillsbury -- Original))

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Spray a 10-inch cast-iron skillet with cooking spray; set aside. Unroll refrigerated dough over lightly floured surface.

raw.text: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Spray a 10-inch cast-iron skillet with cooking spray; set aside. Unroll refrigerated dough over lightly floured surface.
raw.name: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Spray a 10-inch cast-iron skillet with cooking spray; set aside. Unroll refrigerated dough over lightly floured surface.

steps.text: Using a 2 1/2-inch round cutter, cut dough into 24 rounds, re-rolling scraps as necessary. Place 1 (1-inch) piece of mozzarella into the center of each round and wrap dough around cheese, pinching seam to seal.

raw.text: Using a 2 1/2-inch round cutter, cut dough into 24 rounds, re-rolling scraps as necessary.  Place 1 (1-inch) piece of mozzarella into the center of each round and wrap dough around cheese, pinching seam to seal.
raw.name: Using a 2 1/2-inch round cutter, cut dough into 24 rounds, re-rolling scraps as necessary.  Place 1 (1-inch) piece of mozzarella into the center of each round and wrap dough around cheese, pinching seam to seal.

steps.text: Arrange balls/rolls in prepared skillet, seam side down. In addition, place 3/8-inch pieces of mozzarella between rolls. Bake for 15 minutes, or until golden brown. Then sprinkle with Parmesan and bake an additional 5 minutes.

raw.text: Arrange balls/rolls in prepared skillet, seam side down. In addition, place 3/8-inch pieces of mozzarella between rolls. Bake for 15 minutes, or until golden brown. Then sprinkle with Parmesan and bake an additional 5 minutes.
raw.name: Arrange balls/rolls in prepared skillet, seam side down. In addition, place 3/8-inch pieces of mozzarella between rolls. Bake for 15 minutes, or until golden brown. Then sprinkle with Parmesan and bake an additional 5 minutes.

steps.text: Meanwhile, stir together melted butter, olive oil, chopped parsley, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, and 1/2 tsp salt in a small bowl. Brush rolls with butter mixture as soon as they come out of the oven. Serve immediately and enjoy!

review.reviewBody: Bread rolls is one of my favorites, I think there is something in it that makes it so interesting to my taste buds.  But I can’t remember when I tasted anything like this cheese stuffed bread rolls. I immediately grab the chance and bake it myself, and it’s really good! I might have something to sell this time of pandemic!
